Victoria.note: Operator documents the 2017 move from downtown into the former Playhouse Cinema at 1205 Sam Houston Drive and names its own local board. Old Overture and IMLS rows give 204 North Main, the same museum domain, and matching museum name; Overture phone 3614859140 also matches the current operator. Count one museum with both former-address records retained in the old site group. Use the current full public name, Children's Discovery Museum of the Golden Crescent. Preserve source points and aliases.

Maine.note: Operator explicitly documents closure of its Augusta premises during the pandemic and purchase of 7 Eustis Parkway, Waterville, in 2020; its new exhibit hall is open and it lists its own board. The old Overture/IMLS cluster gives 171 Capitol Street Suite 2 and the same official domain. Reconcile all three source rows into one current institution, retaining two former-site records. Use current public name Children's Discovery Museum of Central Maine; relocation is not an additional museum.

Normal.note: The museum expressly links its public location 101 East Beaufort to foundation legal name, 11 Uptown Circle and EIN 371288369, exactly matching IMLS. Overture is the same physical museum and phone. Keep one museum; the foundation mailing identity is supporting data, not an extra visitor institution. Current municipal director oversees the museum and cultural venues; her past job at McLean County Museum does not establish common ownership. Retain one locally operated museum and remove Overture's appended location qualifier using the current public name Children's Discovery Museum.

Kelso.note: Current operator describes its own local nonprofit museum, founded in 2016, moving through Three Rivers Mall and Commerce Avenue to Catlin Elementary School at 404 Long Avenue in 2024. Overture now carries that exact address, domain and phone, but its point remains in Longview; preserve that source coordinate and require a separate visitor-map correction. School-district partnership and sponsors are not museum-chain ownership. One independent institution with the existing public name is supported; dated source point is not certified for visitor use.

GrandRapids.note: Operator explicitly describes two named museums under one nonprofit on the 2727 South Pokegama campus: Children's Discovery Museum and Judy Garland Museum. Preserve them as distinct named institutions and record common parent affiliation. The children's Overture row matches its address/domain/phone and has complete factual review. Related Judy Garland baseline cluster retains a separate 19 Northeast Fourth Street source address whose history still needs a bridge; the IMLS Judy Garland Children's Museum legal-parent row at 2727/PO Box 724 cannot yet be assigned to a single named museum. Those two related identities remain pending; do not merge by common ownership or assign the parent arbitrarily.

California.note: IMLS identifies two separate old rows: Carlsbad at 2787 State Street without EIN, and Encinitas at 265 Village Run West with EIN 330534412. An organization volunteer listing describes the Carlsbad museum; secondary closure leads are not sufficient primary evidence for a current-status decision. No verified bridge joins these rows or links them to the separately represented Escondido museum, which has a different address and EIN. Preserve both pending and unknown; do not infer closure, independence, or not_museum from a residential/mail address or missing current website.

Minden.note: Current operator explicitly identifies Harold Warp Pioneer Village at 138 East US Highway 6 and the Harold Warp Pioneer Village Foundation that operates this museum complex. Its multiple historic buildings and collections form one visitor institution. Campground and other amenities are not separate museums. Overture address and phone match. Use the full public name and record independent foundation operation; do not confuse the separately named Pioneer Village Field with the museum.

Salem.note: Operator places Salem in 1630: Pioneer Village at 98 West Avenue, within Forest River Park. Both Overture rows refer to that same park museum via their domains and IMLS names Forest River Park; reconcile three records, preserving the displaced IMLS point. The city directory explicitly assigns one director to Witch House and Pioneer Village, supporting city common-parent affiliation without merging distinct museums. Operator home and visit pages disagree on the 2026 closing date and include a weather closure banner: recheck access before publication; recorded review does not certify current opening or map points.

WitchHouse.note: The Witch House operator gives 310 1/2 Essex Street; both existing baseline members give 310 Essex and the Overture domain matches. Preserve that existing museum cluster. Current city directory explicitly assigns one director to Witch House and Pioneer Village; record common city affiliation. Salem Witch Museum is a separate institution and is not included in this affiliation decision.

Nobles.note: The society documents its 2021 move from the library to 225 Ninth Street, matching Overture. Its grantor's 2018 filing identifies EIN 416029584 and 407 Twelfth Street Suite 2, exactly matching IMLS; preserve that former museum location. The county directory confirms the current name Nobles County Heritage Center. Reconcile old/current center records, while retaining the separate seasonal Pioneer Village at 1600 Stower Drive. The operator describes both museums, establishing common society affiliation. An apparent 11 p.m. opening-hour typo on the village page needs checking before visitor instructions.

Corsicana.note: City and its visitors bureau identify Pioneer Village at 912 West Park Avenue, the same address as IMLS Navarro County Historical Society; museum phone matches Overture. The city describes one integrated walk-through museum campus holding multiple collections, with the local nonprofit society as partner; the visitors bureau names its president. Reconcile society and village records into that one institution. Component collection names do not create additional institutions; Pearce Museum at Navarro College is unrelated. The nearby Hardgrave Museum row has a different address/EIN and is not merged.

Searcy.note: City identifies Pioneer Village at 1200 Veterans Way and phone 5012785010; the museum-named Overture row has the same phone with older Higginson Street address. Society history documents its move from the fairgrounds to this site in 2002. The 2026 city agreement assigns historic buildings to society maintenance and grounds/city property to city maintenance. Overall review and affiliation remain pending: determine treatment of society's separate office/archive at 112 West Race and other historic sites; city 2026 relocation engineering work also requires a current visitor-location check. Rison.note: The society positively describes Pioneer Village in Rison as an integrated museum campus and its relocated buildings. Overture gives200 Yaney Drive.
